title: Lincolnshire road-verge supply scenarios by harvest radius and cut width
authors: Aaron E. Brown; Judith S. Ford; Catherine S. E. Bale; Miller A. Camargo-Valero; Nick J. Cheffins; Patrick E. Mason; Andrew M. Price-Allison; Andrew B. Ross; Peter G. Taylor
scenario_basis: Rural-road network within radii of operating AD plants; one annual cut; assumed fresh yield 12.5 tonnes per hectare; swath widths of 1.2, 2, and 3 metres.
method: Authors combine road GIS lengths and width-derived area with the stated single-cut yield assumption. Table values are reported, not independently recalculated.
limitations: Scenario estimates are not measured harvested tonnes, accessible tonnes, or supplier contracts.
The stated 12.5 t/ha yield is an assumed fresh-mass yield and cannot be interpreted as dry matter yield.
UK geography and 2016 road/AD-plant context do not transfer directly to Dutch project supply.
No seasonal split, ecological retention constraint, contamination adjustment, transport payload, or delivered-mass loss is represented.
redistribution_note: Contains limited attributed numeric data and metadata; the publication is CC BY 4.0.
